method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: compilation from legislation.wa.gov.au (mrdoc 49346, retrieved 7 September 2026); no compilation number stated; latest amendment in the compilation table (Education and Care Services National Law Application Act 2026 Pt 6 Div 5) in force 1 May 2026; last reprint listed Reprint 7 as at 23 October 2015; uncommenced Evidence Act 2025 Pt 12 Div 19 not shown; Spent Convictions Regulations 1992 not deposited (the $100 minor punishment is the Act's own figure; s 28(2) prescriptions are inputs)

scope: ss 3, 4 (conviction; what Part 2 does not reach), 6, 7, 8 and Schedule 2 (how a conviction becomes spent), 9, 10 (serious and lesser), 11, 32 (prescribed period), 12 (what Part 3 treats as spent), 14, 15 (where the protection stops), 17-24 (discrimination), 25-28 (disclosure, other laws, character, records), 30 (no revival), Schedule 1 cll 1, 3, 7, 8 (the application to the judge), Schedule 3 (22 of its roles, as data)
seat: the person with an old matter (is it spent, and must I disclose it?)

roles: I was convicted of an offence, or charged with one
I employ, engage, license or deal with someone who has an old conviction or charge

situation_parameters.name: I was convicted
situation_parameters.description: Whether your matter ended with a conviction, in Western Australia or elsewhere (if it ended without one, or never came to court, the questions about a conviction's kind, period and how it becomes spent do not arise)
situation_parameters.role: I was convicted of an offence, or charged with one
questions: What kind of conviction is mine under the Act
How long is the prescribed period for my conviction
From what day may I apply to have my conviction spent
How can my conviction become spent, and may I apply now
Is my conviction spent under the Act

situation_parameters.name: I have applied, or will apply, to a District Court judge to have a serious conviction spent
situation_parameters.description: Whether you have applied, or are about to apply, to a District Court judge under s 6 (the questions on the hearing and costs, Schedule 1, arise only then)
situation_parameters.role: I was convicted of an offence, or charged with one
questions: Will my application to a District Court judge be heard in private
Can I be ordered to pay costs on my application to a District Court judge

situation_parameters.name: the person was convicted
